exams.notes: Applicant must submit license fee within one year after passing the examination.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Indiana Real Estate Commission or its duly appointed agent)
exams.quote: pass a written examination prepared and administered by the commission or its duly appointed agent

interval_years.quote: Beginning July 1, 2014, licenses issued under this article are for a term of three (3) years and expire on the date set by the licensing agency.

required.quote: an individual who is licensed as a real estate broker under IC 25-34.1-3-4.1 must complete the approved education requirement each year.

hours_per_period.quote: At least twelve (12) hours per year and at least thirty-six (36) hours per three (3) year renewal cycle

period_years.quote: at least thirty-six (36) hours per three (3) year renewal cycle

value: Legislative issues affecting the real estate practice
topical_requirements.quote: At least twelve (12) hours per year and at least thirty-six (36) hours per three (3) year renewal cycle in any of the following subjects, as determined by the commission: (A) License and escrow law. (B) Anti-trust law. (C) Civil rights law. (D) Agency law. (E) Listing contracts and purchase agreements. (F) Ethics and professionals standards. (G) Settlement procedures. (H) Appraising. (I) Property management. (J) Farm property management. (K) Commercial brokerage and leasing. (L) Financing. (M) Residential brokerage. (N) Land development. (O) Legislative issues affecting the real estate practice.

available.quote: The requirements of subsections (a) and (b) may be waived for individuals who reside in or are moving from other jurisdictions if the following requirements are met: (1) The jurisdiction grants the same privilege to the licensees of this state. (2) The individual is licensed in that jurisdiction. (3) The licensing requirements of that jurisdiction are substantially similar to the requirements of this chapter.

requirements.value: Requirements of subsections (a) and (b) may be waived if: (1) the other jurisdiction grants the same privilege to Indiana licensees; (2) the individual is licensed in that jurisdiction; (3) the licensing requirements of that jurisdiction are substantially similar; and (4) the applicant states they have studied and will abide by Indiana statutes and rules. The reciprocity requirement in (1) need not be met for individuals moving to Indiana.
requirements.quote: The requirements of subsections (a) and (b) may be waived for individuals who reside in or are moving from other jurisdictions if the following requirements are met: (1) The jurisdiction grants the same privilege to the licensees of this state. (2) The individual is licensed in that jurisdiction. (3) The licensing requirements of that jurisdiction are substantially similar to the requirements of this chapter. (4) The applicant states that the applicant has studied, is familiar with, and will abide by the statutes and rules of this state.

exists.quote: The Indiana real estate commission is created.

credential_type.quote: the commission shall issue the applicant a broker license and an identification card which certifies the issuance of the license and indicates the expiration date of the license.

is_mandatory.quote: no person shall, for consideration, sell, buy, trade, exchange, option, lease, rent, manage, list, or appraise real estate or negotiate or offer to perform any of those acts in Indiana or with respect to real estate situated in Indiana, without a license.

title_protection.quote: "Broker" means a person who: (A) for consideration, sells, buys, trades, exchanges, options, leases, rents, manages, lists, or appraises real estate or negotiates or offers to perform any of those acts; and (B) is acting in association with and under the auspices of a managing broker and broker company.

scope_protection.quote: no person shall, for consideration, sell, buy, trade, exchange, option, lease, rent, manage, list, or appraise real estate or negotiate or offer to perform any of those acts in Indiana or with respect to real estate situated in Indiana, without a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing acts of a broker without a broker license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who performs the acts of a broker without a broker license commits a Class A infraction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A licensee convicted of a crime that substantially relates to the practice of real estate may be disciplined
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee who is convicted of a crime that substantially relates to the practice of real estate may be disciplined under IC 25-1-11 .

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of credit service organization statute or mortgage rescue protection fraud statute by a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of: (1) IC 24-5-15 ; or (2) IC 24-5.5 ; by a person licensed or required to be licensed under this article is a violation of this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A licensee who is convicted of a crime must send a copy of the complaint and judgment of conviction to the commission within 30 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee who is convicted of a crime (as defined in IC 33-23-1-4 ) shall send a copy of the: (1) complaint or other information that describes the crime; and (2) judgment of conviction; to the commission not more than thirty (30) days after the date of the conviction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Embezzlement of money or property, or unlawfully obtaining money or property by false pretenses, trickery, or forgery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: embezzlement of money or property; or unlawfully obtaining money or property by false pretenses, use of a device, trickery, or forgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain required trust accounts or commingling of client funds with personal or business funds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The broker company shall not use any trust account for the deposit of any personal funds or other business funds

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to fulfill continuing education requirements may result in denial of license renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the commission may deny renewal of the license of a licensee that does not fulfill the requirements of this chapter.

bonding_required.quote: To obtain course approval, a person must apply to the commission by submitting a bond in the amount of ten thousand dollars ($10,000)

methods_authorized.quote: for consideration, sells, buys, trades, exchanges, options, leases, rents, manages, lists, or appraises real estate or negotiates or offers to perform any of those acts

license_tiers.quote: "Managing broker" refers to an individual broker whom the commission holds responsible for the actions of licensees who are affiliated with the broker company.

broker_of_record_required.quote: have a licensed broker who qualifies as a managing broker under IC 25-34.1-4-0.5 and IC 25-34.1-4-3

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: to become a managing broker, an individual must: (1) hold an active broker's license for at least three (3) years;

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: The required curriculum for brokers shall consist of a total of at least ninety (90) hours of instruction

value: Indiana license law and professional standards
required_instruction_topics.quote: The required curriculum for brokers shall consist of a total of at least ninety (90) hours of instruction and shall include the following subjects: principles, practices, Indiana license law and professional standards, law of agency, contracts, financing, settlement procedures, escrow responsibility, recordkeeping, government regulations, and appraising.

exam_application_window_years.quote: within one (1) year after passing the commission examination, submit the license fee established by the commission under IC 25-1-8-2 .

agency_relationship_types.quote: A licensee has an agency relationship with, and is representing, the individual with whom the licensee is working unless: (1) there is a written agreement to the contrary; or (2) the licensee is merely assisting the individual as a customer without compensation.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A licensee may act as a limited agent only with the written consent of all parties to a real estate transaction.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: An individual licensee affiliated with a broker company represents only the client with which the licensee is working in an in-house agency relationship. A client represented by an individual licensee affiliated with a broker company is represented only by that licensee to the exclusion of all other licensees.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: the licensee is merely assisting the individual as a customer without compensation.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: At the beginning of an agency relationship, a licensee shall disclose in writing the broker company's written office policy set forth in this section before the disclosure by the potential seller, landlord, buyer, or tenant of any confidential information specific to that potential seller, landlord, buyer, or tenant.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: Buyer agency agreements, or any authority to represent a buyer or tenant, shall show a definite date of expiration and shall be in writing, either on paper or in electronic format

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Listing agreements, or any authority to sell or lease, shall show a definite date of expiration and shall be in writing

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: The broker described in subsection (a)(1) shall retain the documentation that is provided by the out-of-state commercial broker as required under this section, and the records and documents related to a transaction, for at least five (5) years.

escrow_account_required.quote: Each broker company shall do the following: (1) Maintain one (1) or more trust accounts (interest or noninterest bearing). (2) Deposit into a trust account described in subdivision (1) all funds belonging to others that come into the possession of the broker company

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: The broker company shall not use any trust account for the deposit of any personal funds or other business funds

fixed_office_required.quote: The license shall be displayed at the broker's place of business.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Any broker company that maintains two (2) or more separate offices for associated licensees shall notify the commission of the name and address of the broker who manages each office.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: "Broker" means a person who: ... (B) is acting in association with and under the auspices of a managing broker and broker company.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: A broker company may pay compensation directly to a business entity that is owned by a broker and associated with the broker company and that has been formed for the purpose of receiving compensation earned by the broker.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: If any aggrieved person obtains a final judgment in any court against a licensee to recover damages for any act of: (1) embezzlement of money or property; or (2) unlawfully obtaining money or property by false pretenses, use of a device, trickery, or forgery; ... the person may ... file a verified application with the commission for an order directing payment out of the real estate recovery fund

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: The amount that may be paid from the real estate recovery fund may not exceed twenty thousand dollars ($20,000) per judgment

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: an aggregate lifetime limit of fifty thousand dollars ($50,000) with respect to any one (1) licensee.

license_exemptions.quote: This article does not apply to: (1) acts of an attorney which constitute the practice of law; (2) performance by a public official of acts authorized by law; (3) acts of a receiver, executor, administrator, commissioner, trustee, or guardian ...
